description_en: Stops an IPC device from actively triggering recording
description_zh: 调用该接口使IPC设备停止主动触发录像
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual stop-triggered-record --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y590000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --record-id fc82774fa749485bad7d719f96700000 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopTriggeredRecord

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。

parameters.description_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console, or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to query the information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** serves as the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device.

You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the ID.
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>IPC的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。

可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。
